scope: Local strict reserve-adapter result validation against caller-selected expectations; no compiler invocation or runtime admission

validation.skipScope: Existing Linux-only check on the local non-Linux host

resultContract.encoding: Strict UTF-8 JSON with duplicate member names, fractional/exponent/negative numeric tokens, non-finite constants, malformed or oversized output refused; bounded canonical integer tokens preserve exact u64 values.
resultContract.schemas: Exact mode-specific fields, schema version, state and scope. All 13 capability and verification flags must be literal false; required descriptive assertions must be literal true.
resultContract.externalSelection: Exact caller-selected plan digest, baseline genesis, account count and total. Prepare additionally binds reserve address and units. Review additionally binds distinct proposed genesis and the selected creation-time-change boolean. Selection must come from independently selected input, never from returned stdout.
resultContract.compilerInput: Prepare requires exactly one selected reserve entry with an exact integer balance, System owner, empty-data marker and literal false executable flag. No additional, missing or duplicate fields or accounts.
resultContract.failureHandling: A fixed SELECTED_RESERVE_RESULT_REFUSED error with no raw input, key material, paths or parser diagnostics.

limitations: This validates syntax, schema and equality to caller-supplied expectations. It does not independently derive a reserve PDA or validate the full plan, authenticate decoder execution or complete account history, or accept compiler results.

The adapter output does not include raw decoder report digests. The integrating caller must separately validate the input selectors and trusted artifact execution; output assertions alone are not independent evidence of account bytes.

The two actual Node invocations use the retained synthetic two-account fixture and unchanged bundle through the existing bounded selected-process helper. Expected fields come from the pinned input; the proposed reserve address is a separately fixed fixture expectation. Six corrupted versions of those outputs refuse. No compiler, decoder, key generator, validator, chain operation or fresh genesis was run.

Large u64 values, duplicate fields, encoding, numeric-token ambiguity, exact output bounds, permissions and mismatched selections are local synthetic parser tests, not a Linux host or runtime admission.

The existing preparation entry point is unchanged and does not call this validator or reserve adapter. Trusted runtime pins, input/output integration, admitted Linux hosting, fresh compilation and two strict slot-zero replays remain required. Backing, custody, operators, monitoring fault delivery and independent review remain open.
